Mavis skill: content-deck-generator v1.0.0. Reads ~/.mavis/fleet/*-draft.md files, parses X (tweet thread) and LinkedIn (longform) buckets, renders standalone dark-theme HTML content deck with numbered tweet cards and a LinkedIn block — each with working Copy Text buttons and 60s auto-refresh. Output: ~/.mavis/fleet/outbound/content-deck.html. Theme: 'Tony Stark / Dark Arc Reactor' — --bg #0d0d0d, --card-bg #1a1a2e, --accent #00aaff, --accent2 #ff3d00. Card structure:
N
...
. Auto-refresh: + inline countdown setInterval. Copy JS: navigator.clipboard.writeText + 'Copied!' feedback. 1.7 line-height for LinkedIn. Mobile responsive (1-col below 700px).
